customDescriptions.value: Create an array of physical connections — use for modeling repeated physical elements like battery cells in series or parallel without manual wiring
Label a physical connection line — use for identifying and organizing physical signal connections in complex Simscape models
Create a physical connection port on a subsystem boundary — use for exposing Simscape physical connections through subsystem interfaces
Convert a Simscape physical signal to a Simulink signal — use for passing measurement data from physical networks into standard Simulink processing
Measure internal variables of a Simscape block — use for extracting physical quantities like current, voltage, or flow without breaking the physical connection
Bundle multiple physical connections into a single bus — use for simplifying wiring in models with many parallel physical connections
Instantiate a custom Simscape component from a .ssc file — use for adding user-defined physical domain components written in Simscape language
Convert a Simulink signal to a Simscape physical signal — use for injecting control commands or setpoints from Simulink into physical network models
Configure the Simscape local solver for a physical network — use at the top level of every Simscape physical network to set solver parameters
Display frequency spectrum of Simscape signals — use for analyzing frequency content of physical system responses
Switch between physical connection variants — use for modeling different physical configurations that can be selected at compile time
